_comment: Hand-verified seed catalog. The COMPREHENSIVE set of work-zone (WZDx) feeds
is discovered at runtime from the live USDOT WZDx Feed Registry via
`freetraffic sources discover-wzdx` -- this file only needs the feeds that
discovery can't find: Open511 event feeds and (eventually) live-speed feeds.
Adding an Open511 or WZDx jurisdiction here is a pure data change.
Set the relevant *_API_KEY environment variable for feeds that need a key.

feeds.name: 511 SF Bay (MTC) - Open511 Traffic Events
feeds.notes: Reference Open511 deployment. Free token: https://511.org/open-data/token

feeds.name: WSDOT Traveler Information - Traffic Flow (sensor speeds)
feeds.notes: Live-speed feed. Needs a dedicated parser (roadmap): returns FlowReadingValue per station, not link speeds. Free key: https://wsdot.wa.gov/traffic/api/

feeds.name: Caltrans PeMS - Detector Station Speeds
feeds.notes: Loop-detector speeds/flow. Requires account + custom export parser (roadmap). One of the few true free live-speed sources in the US.
